about: Record of an official-roster check, used by tools/build_forecast_class.py as a second, independent roster source. Scope: the 29 high-school recruits of the 2025 class only; other players were not checked. Jersey and position are as shown on the page and are secondary identity evidence only: a jersey is not an id (numbers are shared, e.g. #11 and #19) and never establishes roster status by itself.
source: Official Penn State 2026 football roster, gopsusports.com/sports/football/roster (players #0 to #99, followed by the coaching staff)
